en.title: Privacy Policy
lines: English version  |  Effective date: September 30, 2026
1  Who we are

Open World Aviation LLC, a Florida limited liability company, doing business as Open World Aviation ('Open World Aviation,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our'), is responsible for the personal information described in this Privacy Policy. You may contact us regarding privacy or legal matters at contact@openworldaviation.com or by telephone at +1 (305) 430-5398.
2  Scope

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, retain, and protect personal information when you visit www.openworldaviation.com, submit a contact form, communicate with us by email, telephone, or WhatsApp, or inquire about our aircraft management, aircraft sales and acquisitions, charter coordination or advisory, aviation consulting, corporate aviation solutions, or aviation logistics services.
This policy applies to website and business-inquiry information. Transaction-specific agreements, operator notices, employment notices, and service-provider policies may apply separately.
3  Information we collect
•  Contact and professional information, such as your name, email address, telephone or WhatsApp number, company, title, country, and preferred method of contact.

•  Inquiry and correspondence information, including the service requested, aircraft interests or requirements, travel or operational preferences you choose to provide, message contents, and our communications with you.
•  Technical information ordinarily generated when a website is used, such as IP address, browser and device type, operating system, referring page, date and time, security events, and server logs.

•  Transaction and due-diligence information provided later in a business relationship, only when reasonably necessary for a potential engagement and subject to appropriate safeguards or separate documentation.

Please do not submit passports, financial account information, medical information, passenger manifests, aircraft records, or other sensitive or confidential materials through the public contact form. We do not knowingly collect personal information from third-party data brokers through this website.
4  How we use information
•  Respond to inquiries and communicate about requested services.
•  Evaluate and develop potential aircraft management, sale, acquisition, charter advisory, consulting, corporate aviation, or logistics engagements.
•  Operate, secure, troubleshoot, and improve the website and prevent fraud or misuse.
•  Maintain business records, manage relationships, enforce agreements, and protect legal rights.
•  Comply with applicable laws, regulatory requests, sanctions, export-control, anti-fraud, know-your-customer, and other lawful due-diligence requirements where relevant.

Where applicable, we rely on one or more lawful grounds: your consent; steps requested by you before entering a contract; performance of a contract; compliance with legal obligations; and our legitimate interests in operating, securing, and developing our business, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights.
5  How we disclose information
We may disclose personal information only as reasonably necessary to:
•  Website hosting, information technology, email, communications, security, and professional service providers acting for us.

•  Aircraft owners, sellers, buyers, operators, management providers, maintenance organizations, insurers, lenders, escrow agents, title companies, advisors, and other transaction participants when needed to evaluate or perform a requested service and subject to appropriate confidentiality expectations.
•  Government, regulatory, law-enforcement, or judicial authorities when required or permitted by law.
•  A potential successor or transaction counterparty in a merger, financing, reorganization, sale of assets, or similar corporate event, subject to appropriate protections.

We do not sell personal information for money. At launch, we do not use personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising or share it with advertising networks. If that practice changes, this policy and any required choices will be updated before the change takes effect.
6  WhatsApp and external services

If you choose the WhatsApp link, you leave our website and communicate through a service operated by a third party. That provider may process your identifiers, device information, communications metadata, and message content under its own terms and privacy policy. Do not send sensitive documents over WhatsApp unless we have expressly agreed that the method is appropriate.
7  International transfers

Our clients, prospects, aircraft, operators, and service providers may be located in different countries. Personal information may therefore be processed outside your country, including in countries whose privacy laws may differ. Where required, we will use an appropriate legal basis and safeguards for international transfers.
8  Retention

We retain contact-form submissions and ordinary business inquiries for as long as reasonably necessary to respond, develop a potential relationship, document communications, and protect legal rights, generally no longer than 24 months after the last substantive interaction unless a longer period is required for an active engagement, legal obligation, dispute, or legitimate recordkeeping need. Contract, transaction, tax, compliance, and due-diligence records may be retained for the applicable legal or professional retention period. Technical and security logs are retained only as long as reasonably needed for security, diagnostics, and legal compliance.
9  Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards appropriate to the nature of the information. No internet transmission or storage system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. If you believe information sent to us has been compromised, contact us promptly at contact@openworldaviation.com or +1 (305) 430-5398.
10  Your choices and privacy rights

Depending on where you live and whether a particular law applies to us, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or objection; to withdraw consent; and to appeal or complain to a supervisory authority. You may also request information about certain disclosures or opt out of covered sales, sharing, or targeted advertising. We do not discriminate against anyone for exercising an applicable privacy right.

Submit a request to contact@openworldaviation.com. We may need to verify your identity and authority. We will respond within the period required by applicable law. An authorized agent may submit a request where legally permitted, subject to verification. These statements do not create rights that do not otherwise apply under law.
11  Children

This website is intended for business and professional users and is not directed to children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children through the website. If you believe a child has provided information, contact us so we can evaluate and delete it as appropriate.
12  Cookies

At launch, the website is intended to use only cookies or similar technologies that are necessary for basic operation, security, and form functionality. See our Cookie Policy for current details. Non-essential analytics or advertising technologies must not be activated without updating the relevant notices and consent controls.
13  Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices, services, technology, or legal obligations. The revised version will be posted with a new effective date. Material changes will be communicated in an appropriate manner when required.
14  Contact
Privacy questions and requests may be sent to Open World Aviation LLC at contact@openworldaviation.com or by telephone at +1 (305) 430-5398. Website: www.openworldaviation.com.

en.title: Terms of Use
lines: English version  |  Effective date: September 30, 2026
1  Acceptance

These Terms of Use govern access to www.openworldaviation.com and its content. By using the website, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the website. These Terms do not replace any separate written agreement signed by you and Open World Aviation LLC.
2  Informational website only

The website provides general information about Open World Aviation and potential aviation services. Website content is not a binding offer, quotation, commitment, warranty, reservation, or contract. No aircraft acquisition, sale, lease, management engagement, charter arrangement, consulting engagement, or other service is created until the relevant parties execute definitive written agreements and all required conditions are satisfied.
3  Our role

Depending on the engagement, Open World Aviation may act as an independent consultant, advisor, intermediary, broker, or aircraft-management service provider. The exact role, scope, fees, authority, and responsibilities will be stated in a separate written agreement.

Unless expressly stated in a signed agreement and legally authorized, Open World Aviation is not an air carrier, does not itself operate charter flights, does not exercise operational control over third-party aircraft or operators, and does not provide legal, tax, accounting, engineering, appraisal, insurance, or investment advice.
4  Aircraft information and availability

Aircraft descriptions, photographs, specifications, times, maintenance status, ownership information, price indications, and availability may come from owners, operators, manufacturers, databases, or other sources believed reliable. They may be incomplete, approximate, outdated, or subject to error. Aircraft may be sold, leased, withdrawn, substituted, or repriced without notice.

Prospective parties must perform independent inspections, records reviews, title and lien searches, regulatory checks, valuations, and professional due diligence. Website information must not be relied upon as a representation or warranty of condition, title, airworthiness, value, performance, or fitness for a particular purpose.
5  Charter coordination and advisory

Any charter opportunity is subject to aircraft and crew availability, operator acceptance, safety and operational requirements, weather, airport limitations, permits, sanctions screening, and applicable law. Transportation is provided only by the air carrier identified in the definitive charter documentation. That carrier retains operational control and responsibility for the flight. Quotes may change until confirmed in a signed agreement and may exclude taxes, repositioning, deicing, catering, ground transport, Wi-Fi, permits, or other charges unless expressly included.
6  Regulatory and geographic limitations

Services are offered only where lawful. Nothing on the website is intended to solicit or conduct an activity requiring a license, registration, authorization, or approval that Open World Aviation does not hold. Availability may be restricted by aviation, customs, immigration, sanctions, export-control, anti-money-laundering, consumer-protection, or other laws.
7  User responsibilities

You agree to provide accurate information, use the website lawfully, and refrain from interfering with its security or operation. You may not attempt unauthorized access, introduce malicious code, scrape or harvest data at scale, impersonate another person, misuse contact information, or use content for unlawful, misleading, or competitive republication.
8  Intellectual property

The website, its design, text, graphics, branding, and original content are owned by or licensed to Open World Aviation and are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. You may view and print limited portions for your own legitimate business evaluation. No other copying, modification, distribution, republication, framing, or commercial use is permitted without prior written consent. Third-party aircraft photographs, marks, and materials remain the property of their respective owners.
9  External links

Links to WhatsApp and other third-party websites are provided for convenience. We do not control or endorse their content, security, availability, terms, or privacy practices. Your use of a third-party service is governed by that provider's terms.
10  Disclaimer of warranties

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, THE WEBSITE AND ITS CONTENT ARE PROVIDED 'AS IS' AND 'AS AVAILABLE.' OPEN WORLD AVIATION DISCLAIMS ALL EXPRESS, IMPLIED, AND STATUTORY WARRANTIES, INCLUDING WARRANTIES OF ACCURACY, COMPLETENESS, MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT, AVAILABILITY, AND SECURITY. SOME JURISDICTIONS DO NOT ALLOW CERTAIN DISCLAIMERS, SO PARTS OF THIS SECTION MAY NOT APPLY TO YOU.

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, OPEN WORLD AVIATION AND ITS OWNERS, OFFICERS, EMPLOYEES, CONTRACTORS, AND AGENTS WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, LOST PROFITS, LOST OPPORTUNITIES, LOSS OF DATA, OR BUSINESS INTERRUPTION ARISING FROM OR RELATED TO THE WEBSITE OR RELIANCE ON ITS CONTENT. FOR CLAIMS BASED SOLELY ON WEBSITE USE, OUR AGGREGATE LIABILITY WILL NOT EXCEED USD 100. THESE LIMITATIONS DO NOT EXCLUDE LIABILITY THAT CANNOT LAWFULLY BE LIMITED.
12  Indemnification

To the extent permitted by law, you agree to indemnify and hold harmless Open World Aviation and its owners, officers, employees, contractors, and agents from third-party claims, losses, and reasonable costs arising from your unlawful website use, your material violation of these Terms, or content you submit in violation of another person's rights.
13  Governing law and venue

These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles. Subject to any non-waivable law, exclusive jurisdiction and venue will lie in the state or federal courts of competent jurisdiction in Florida.
14  Changes and severability

We may update these Terms by posting a revised version and effective date. Continued use after a change constitutes acceptance to the extent permitted by law. If any provision is found unenforceable, it will be limited or removed to the minimum extent necessary, and the remaining provisions will continue in effect. Failure to enforce a provision is not a waiver.
15  Language and contact
The English version controls if there is a conflict with a translation. Questions may be sent to Open World Aviation LLC at contact@openworldaviation.com or by telephone at +1 (305) 430-5398.

es.title: Política de Privacidad
lines: Traducción al español  |  Fecha de vigencia: 30 de septiembre de 2026
1  Quiénes somos

Open World Aviation LLC, una sociedad de responsabilidad limitada de Florida que opera bajo el nombre Open World Aviation ('Open World Aviation', 'nosotros' o 'nuestro'), es responsable de la información personal descripta en esta Política. Puede contactarnos por asuntos de privacidad o legales en contact@openworldaviation.com o por teléfono al +1 (305) 430-5398.
2  Alcance

Esta Política explica cómo recopilamos, utilizamos, divulgamos, conservamos y protegemos información personal cuando usted visita www.openworldaviation.com, envía un formulario, se comunica por email, teléfono o WhatsApp, o consulta por servicios de administración de aeronaves, compraventa y adquisición, coordinación o asesoramiento de vuelos charter, consultoría aeronáutica, soluciones de aviación corporativa o logística aeronáutica.
Esta Política cubre el sitio y las consultas comerciales. Podrán aplicar por separado contratos específicos, avisos de operadores, avisos laborales y políticas de proveedores.
3  Información que recopilamos
•  Datos de contacto y profesionales, como nombre, email, teléfono o WhatsApp, empresa, cargo, país y medio de contacto preferido.

•  Datos de consultas y comunicaciones, incluido el servicio solicitado, intereses o necesidades respecto de aeronaves, preferencias operativas o de viaje que usted decida informar, mensajes y comunicaciones posteriores.

•  Datos técnicos generados normalmente al usar un sitio, como dirección IP, navegador, dispositivo, sistema operativo, página de referencia, fecha, hora, eventos de seguridad y registros del servidor.

•  Información transaccional y de debida diligencia suministrada posteriormente, únicamente cuando sea razonablemente necesaria para una posible contratación y con salvaguardas o documentación apropiadas.

No envíe pasaportes, cuentas financieras, información médica, manifiestos de pasajeros, registros de aeronaves ni otros materiales sensibles o confidenciales mediante el formulario público. No recopilamos deliberadamente información personal de intermediarios de datos de terceros a través de este sitio.
4  Cómo usamos la información
•  Responder consultas y comunicarnos sobre servicios solicitados.
•  Evaluar y desarrollar posibles encargos de management, venta, adquisición, asesoramiento charter, consultoría, aviación corporativa o logística.
•  Operar, proteger, diagnosticar y mejorar el sitio, y prevenir fraude o uso indebido.
•  Mantener registros, gestionar relaciones, exigir contratos y proteger derechos legales.
•  Cumplir leyes, requerimientos regulatorios, sanciones, controles de exportación, prevención de fraude, conocimiento del cliente y otras verificaciones lícitas cuando correspondan.

Cuando corresponda, el tratamiento se basa en el consentimiento; medidas precontractuales solicitadas; ejecución de un contrato; obligaciones legales; o intereses legítimos en operar, proteger y desarrollar el negocio, siempre que no prevalezcan los derechos del titular.
5  Cómo divulgamos información
Podemos divulgar información personal solo cuando sea razonablemente necesario a:
•  Proveedores de hosting, tecnología, email, comunicaciones, seguridad y servicios profesionales que trabajan para nosotros.

•  Propietarios, vendedores, compradores, operadores, managers, talleres, aseguradoras, financiadores, agentes de escrow, compañías de títulos, asesores y otros participantes, cuando sea necesario para evaluar o prestar un servicio solicitado y bajo expectativas adecuadas de confidencialidad.
•  Autoridades gubernamentales, regulatorias, judiciales o policiales cuando la ley lo permita o exija.
•  Un eventual sucesor o contraparte en una fusión, financiación, reorganización, venta de activos u operación similar, con protecciones apropiadas.

No vendemos información personal a cambio de dinero. Al lanzamiento no usamos datos para publicidad conductual entre contextos ni los compartimos con redes publicitarias. Si esta práctica cambiara, se actualizarán previamente la Política y las opciones exigidas.
6  WhatsApp y servicios externos

Al utilizar el enlace de WhatsApp, usted sale de nuestro sitio y se comunica mediante un servicio externo. Ese proveedor puede tratar identificadores, datos del dispositivo, metadatos y contenido bajo sus propios términos y política. No envíe documentos sensibles por WhatsApp salvo que hayamos acordado expresamente que el medio es adecuado.
7  Transferencias internacionales

Nuestros clientes, prospectos, aeronaves, operadores y proveedores pueden encontrarse en distintos países. Por ello, la información puede tratarse fuera de su país, incluso donde las leyes de privacidad sean diferentes. Cuando corresponda, utilizaremos una base legal y salvaguardas adecuadas.
8  Conservación

Conservamos formularios y consultas durante el tiempo razonablemente necesario para responder, desarrollar una posible relación, documentar comunicaciones y proteger derechos; en general, no más de 24 meses desde la última interacción sustancial, salvo que una contratación activa, obligación legal, controversia o necesidad legítima de archivo requiera un plazo mayor. Los registros contractuales, fiscales, transaccionales, de cumplimiento y debida diligencia podrán conservarse durante el plazo legal o profesional aplicable. Los registros técnicos y de seguridad se conservan solo mientras sean razonablemente necesarios.
9  Seguridad

Aplicamos salvaguardas administrativas, técnicas y organizativas razonables. Ninguna transmisión o almacenamiento es absolutamente seguro. Si considera que información enviada a nosotros fue comprometida, contacte de inmediato a contact@openworldaviation.com o al +1 (305) 430-5398.
10  Opciones y derechos

Según su residencia y la ley aplicable, usted puede tener derechos de acceso, corrección, eliminación, limitación, portabilidad u oposición; retirar consentimiento; apelar; o reclamar ante una autoridad. También puede tener derecho a conocer ciertas divulgaciones u oponerse a ventas, intercambios o publicidad dirigida cubiertos por la ley. No discriminamos por ejercer un derecho aplicable.

Envíe su solicitud a contact@openworldaviation.com. Podremos verificar identidad y representación. Responderemos en el plazo exigido. Un representante autorizado podrá presentar una solicitud cuando la ley lo permita, sujeto a verificación. Estas declaraciones no crean derechos que no resulten aplicables legalmente.
11  Menores

El sitio está destinado a usuarios comerciales y profesionales, no a menores de 18 años. No recopilamos deliberadamente datos de menores mediante el sitio. Si cree que un menor proporcionó información, contáctenos para evaluarla y eliminarla cuando corresponda.
12  Cookies

En el lanzamiento, el sitio está previsto para utilizar únicamente cookies o tecnologías necesarias para operación, seguridad y funcionamiento del formulario. Consulte la Política de Cookies. No deberán activarse tecnologías no esenciales de analítica o publicidad sin actualizar avisos y controles de consentimiento.
13  Modificaciones

Podemos actualizar esta Política por cambios en prácticas, servicios, tecnología u obligaciones legales. Publicaremos la versión revisada con una nueva fecha y comunicaremos cambios relevantes cuando la ley lo exija.
14  Contacto
Las consultas y solicitudes de privacidad pueden enviarse a Open World Aviation LLC a contact@openworldaviation.com o por teléfono al +1 (305) 430-5398. Sitio web: www.openworldaviation.com.

Esta Política explica cómo [LEGAL COMPANY NAME], bajo el nombre Open World Aviation, utiliza cookies y tecnologías similares en [WEBSITE DOMAIN]. Debe leerse junto con la Política de Privacidad.
2  Qué son las cookies

Las cookies son pequeños archivos de texto que se almacenan en un dispositivo al visitar un sitio. Tecnologías similares incluyen almacenamiento local, píxeles, etiquetas y herramientas de software. Pueden permitir funciones esenciales, recordar preferencias, medir uso o habilitar publicidad, según la configuración.
3  Configuración inicial

El sitio está previsto para lanzarse sin analítica, píxeles publicitarios, publicidad conductual ni seguimiento de newsletters. Podrá utilizar tecnologías estrictamente necesarias para hosting, seguridad, balanceo, idioma, sesiones, formulario y prevención de spam. Se usarán solo para prestar lo solicitado o proteger el sitio.
4  Cookies utilizadas

Un enlace normal a WhatsApp u otro sitio no nos permite controlar ese servicio. Al seguirlo, el tercero puede usar sus propias cookies bajo sus políticas. El contenido externo embebido puede comportarse de otra manera y debe evaluarse antes de implementarlo.

Información general

El contenido del sitio tiene fines exclusivamente informativos y de conversación comercial preliminar. No constituye oferta, cotización vinculante, reserva, contrato, declaración, garantía ni asesoramiento profesional.
Brokerage y asesoramiento de aeronaves

Open World Aviation puede actuar como intermediaria, broker o asesora en una posible operación. Salvo acuerdo escrito, no es propietaria de aeronaves publicadas, no garantiza la autoridad de terceros ni certifica independientemente los datos. Especificaciones, equipamiento, tiempos, mantenimiento, condición, título, precio y disponibilidad requieren verificación independiente, inspección, revisión de registros, documentación definitiva y pueden cambiar o retirarse sin aviso.
Management y consultoría

Todo servicio de management o consultoría se regirá exclusivamente por un contrato firmado que defina alcance, autoridad, honorarios, responsabilidad, seguros, cumplimiento y terminación. Las descripciones del sitio no designan a Open World Aviation como manager, agente, fiduciaria, operadora o representante de ninguna persona o aeronave.
Charter y operaciones de vuelo

Salvo que la documentación definitiva identifique expresamente a Open World Aviation como transportador directo debidamente autorizado, Open World Aviation no opera vuelos charter ni ejerce control operacional sobre vuelos de terceros. Cada vuelo será operado por el transportador licenciado identificado, responsable exclusivo del control operacional, tripulación, seguridad, mantenimiento, liberación y cumplimiento. La disponibilidad depende del operador, meteorología, aeropuertos, permisos, tripulación, mantenimiento, seguridad y ley aplicable.
Revisión profesional independiente

Los interesados deben contratar profesionales legales, fiscales, contables, técnicos, de mantenimiento, títulos, escrow, seguros, regulación y tasación. Nada en el sitio debe ser la única base para una decisión aeronáutica, financiera, fiscal, legal u operacional.
Cumplimiento y operaciones restringidas

Open World Aviation puede rechazar o finalizar consultas o encargos por exigencias legales o controles de riesgo, incluidos sanciones, exportaciones, prevención de lavado y corrupción, conocimiento del cliente, origen de fondos, aduanas, migraciones, cabotaje o normativa aeronáutica. No se ofrece ningún servicio donde esté prohibido.
